about_the_game:
SkyInFlames - Military Strategy

Experience intense aerial warfare in this tactical military strategy game!

Take command of advanced drone swarms and sophisticated air defense systems in a realistic military simulation. SkyInFlames puts you in control of cutting-edge military technology as you plan and execute complex aerial operations.

🎯 Key Features:

  • Realistic Drone Warfare: Command Shahed and Gerbera drones with authentic flight physics and targeting systems

  • Advanced Air Defense: Deploy mobile AA units and radar systems to protect critical infrastructure

  • Dual Faction System: Play as either Ukrainian (UA) or Russian Federation (RF) forces with unique units and strategies

  • Strategic Targets: Attack and defend key military and civilian infrastructure including government buildings, power plants, and airports

  • Dynamic Combat: Real-time tactical combat with realistic weapon systems and damage modeling

  • Interactive Map: Navigate detailed OpenStreetMap-based terrain with precise coordinate systems

  • Resource Management: Manage currency and resources to build and maintain your military forces

🎮 Gameplay:

  • Launch drone swarms from strategic launch points

  • Plan complex flight routes and attack patterns

  • Deploy mobile air defense systems to counter enemy threats

  • Manage detection systems and visibility mechanics

  • Coordinate multi-unit operations across vast battlefields

⚔️ Military Units:

  • Attack Drones: Shahed and Gerbera UAVs with different capabilities

  • Mobile AA: Advanced air defense systems with radar guidance

  • Radar Units: Detection and tracking systems for battlefield awareness

  • Strategic Targets: Government quarters, power plants, and critical infrastructure

🌍 Realistic Environment:

  • High-detail OpenStreetMap integration

  • Accurate geographical positioning

  • Real-time weather and visibility effects

  • Dynamic day/night cycles affecting combat

This is a DEMO version showcasing the core gameplay mechanics. Full version will include additional features, campaigns, and multiplayer modes.

Note: This game contains military themes and simulated warfare. Intended for mature audiences.
